title: The inverse-frame restriction is the ordinary affine integration adjunct
statement: Fix a finite purity datum [def-pur-conventions], a separated finite-type k-scheme Z, a rank-d vector bundle F [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], an open U of Z, and any linear trivialization e. At every positive annihilating exponent, restrictedRaw from [def-pur-vector-chart-comparison-coordinates] is HEq to affineTranspose over U, the comparison image of the ordinary ordered affine-counit adjunct defined in [lem-pur-affine-unit-transpose-coordinates]. This equation makes no reference to ordered affine purity. It includes rank zero and empty opens.

source.place: Second paragraph: restriction of the global integration adjunct is the affine-space counit adjunct, before the ordered-purity identification.

proof.text: The normalization supplied by existsUnique_vectorIntegrationGluing gives the restriction of global integration in every frame as the ordinary affine counit after inverse-frame compact-support exchange and canonical coefficient descent. Invert exchange and apply naturality of the ordinary adjunction transpose across its exceptional mate; source and target naturality move the inverse Tate pullback and unit pullback inside the adjunct.

The chart coefficient, composed with inverse base-coefficient pullback for a;f and its pullback compositor, equals the inverse coefficientComparison for the affine projection. Verify by induction on d: at zero it is unit pullback coherence; at a successor apply the tensor pullback compositor and normalized shifted Tate-line pullback coherence, then the induction hypothesis. Substitute in the transposed normalized trace; apply comparison. HEq endpoint transport gives exactly affineTranspose. The proof uses the identity adjunction at rank zero and works for empty opens.

proof_origin.place: Second paragraph: restriction to a trivializing open is the adjunct of the affine-space counit. Expanded using the canonical definitions and stated adjunction comparison lemmas.

theorem chartTranspose_eq_affine (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Z] (aZ : Z ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aZ] [QuasiCompact aZ] [IsSeparated aZ]
    (d : ℕ) (F : Z.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (U : Z.Opens) (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization Z d F U)
    (r : ℕ) (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : Ring P) = 0) :
    letI : IsNoetherian U.toScheme := isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType (U.ι ≫ aZ)
    HEq (restrictedRaw P Z aZ d F U e r hA)
      (affineTranspose P U.toScheme (U.ι ≫ aZ) d r hA)
